work.title: Carmen
work.movement: Act I: Habanera — L’amour est un oiseau rebelle

version.value: French-language solo recording of the Habanera, with orchestral accompaniment; both verses and the closing refrain
version.note: A complete commercial aria side, not a recording of the surrounding stage scene. The English title on the disc describes the aria; the performance is in French. Ensemble participation in the stage score is not claimed for this solo recording.

performers.note: The Library of Congress supplies the conductor for matrix B-15474, take 2. Its catalogued issue is Victor 621; FAU connects the same matrix and take to Victor 87210, the issue digitised here.

date.note: Recording date, distinct from the February 1915 release bulletin and the 2021 Archive accession.

place.note: No particular studio address is asserted.

label.note: The digitised pressing is labelled Victrola; the contemporary release bulletin lists it under the Victor Talking Machine Company.

catalogue.note: Ten-inch, single-sided Red Seal issue, announced in the February 1915 list.

matrixTakeSides.note: IA transcribes an inscription as 3L87210. That inscription is retained as transfer metadata, not substituted for the recording matrix identified by FAU and the Library of Congress.

credits.value: George Blood L.P.; digitisation and metadata: Nicholas Hoffman; cleaning: Kevin Coupe
credits.note: Credits reproduced from the Great 78 Project item metadata.

date.note: The item became public on 19 October 2021. The exact digitisation date is not established and is not replaced by that upload date.

processing.value: Four stylus transfers were made; the selected friendly-filename transfer was preferred by the digitising engineer. Flat and equalised versions are described, with 500 Hz turnover for the latter.
processing.note: The notes name 3.8, 2.3, 2.8 and 3.3 mil truncated-conical styli but do not unambiguously identify the chosen stylus or equalisation for the friendly-filename MP3. Surface noise, distortion and small pops are noted by the archive; no site-side restoration is added.

digital.format: Internet Archive VBR MP3 derivative of the preferred FLAC transfer

composition.value: Public domain: Bizet’s 1875 score and the nineteenth-century French text
composition.note: Bizet died in 1875; the Habanera’s text is his own. This is the original French aria, not a modern translation or arrangement.

recording.value: Public domain in the United States: commercially published in 1915, before the 1923 statutory boundary
recording.note: The Talking Machine World, January 1915, p. 62, lists Victor 87210 under ‘The February Red Seal Records’. This establishes publication independently of the December 1914 session and the Archive’s generic 1914 date. Under the Classics Protection and Access Act, protection for pre-1923 publications ended on 31 December 2021. No worldwide-rights claim is made.

rights.creditLine: Georges Bizet: Carmen, Habanera. Geraldine Farrar; Walter B. Rogers, conductor. Victor 87210, matrix B-15474-2, recorded 9 December 1914. Great 78 Project / George Blood L.P.; transfer Nicholas Hoffman, cleaning Kevin Coupe. Public domain in the United States.
